philosophy: Zero test dependencies. Node 24 strips types and runs node:test via a 20-line resolver in tests/register.mts; Python uses stdlib unittest. There is no Jest/Vitest/Playwright/Cypress and no browser-driving test in the repo.

layers.name: TypeScript suite
layers.validates: Pure editing maths (layout, holes, span delete, reorder, splitBeat), persistence and snapshots, route handlers called directly as functions over Request, upload streaming, corrupt-input handling, review-state integrity, scorecard/tool wording coupling.
layers.doesNotValidate: Anything rendered. No component renders, no DOM, no browser, no CSS, no accessibility, no visual regression, no real ffmpeg/Whisper execution.
layers.countNote: runtimeCounts is authoritative; the static count is lower because tests are generated inside for-loops.

layers.name: Bug board
layers.semantics: DELIBERATELY RED. A test here fails until the ledger bug it names is fixed; a pass is the signal to flip the ledger row. It is counted but does NOT gate ./scripts/test.
layers.currentState: 1 open (S1, closed as wontfix but kept red on purpose), 2 passing (S2, S7).
layers.countNote: runtimeCounts is authoritative; the static count is lower because tests are generated inside for-loops.

layers.name: Python pipeline
layers.validates: walk_pieces (which frames survive a cut), silence-map merging, scoring, data-root resolution.
layers.doesNotValidate: No tool is executed end-to-end against real media by this suite. build_cut's file output, extract.sh, and the concat are untested here.
layers.countNote: runtimeCounts is authoritative; the static count is lower because tests are generated inside for-loops.

layers.name: Gauntlet (property/fuzz)
layers.seeded: qa/rng.mts mulberry32 — every failure reports the seed that reproduces it.
layers.validates: Generated beat lists/EDLs against layout and span-delete invariants; degenerate and hostile inputs; every JSON route against non-object bodies; concurrent writes; review-state corruption; the changed/unchanged contract on every write path.
layers.doesNotValidate: Not run by ./scripts/test or ./scripts/qa — it is a separate command and will NOT run in CI unless wired in. THIS IS A GAP.

layers.name: Media verification
layers.validates: Opens the finished mp4: duration vs EDL (bounded by frame quantisation), streams present, fps, resolution, silent stretches via silencedetect, black frames, every EDL piece inside the source. verify_words checks no spoken word was lost against the transcript.
layers.doesNotValidate: Not automated, not wired to any script, requires a built project. Manual invocation only.

layers.name: Mechanical QA gate
layers.validates: Guards, type check, the TS+Python suites, the bug board, orphaned-API-route sweep, and (deep) knip.

absent: performance budgets or benchmarks in CI
security scanning / dependency audit in CI
CI configuration of any kind (no .github/, no CI file in the repo)
gaps: No coverage tooling: the percentage of lib/ and app/ exercised is UNKNOWN.
The gauntlet and the media verifiers are not invoked by any script, so they only run when a human runs them.
No test executes the Swift launcher, the bundling script, or the app bundle.
No test drives the WKWebView; every UI check in this repo's history was done in a separate Chromium pane against the same server.

totalAutomatedChecks.note: 3,266 checks total. The 3,056 gauntlet scenarios are generated, not hand-written.
